name: radiant-depth
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: the attached castle atlas. Extract ONLY the specified ONE castle into a registered 3-layer transparent sprite atlas. Preserve the original castle's architecture, colors, tower arrangement, exquisite gold detail, rock texture, water cascades, and painterly realism. Do not redesign it. Output a very high-detail wide 3:1 canvas with exactly THREE equal square tiles in a horizontal row. Each tile uses IDENTICAL framing, scale and pixel registration of the SAME castle, with a common level waterline at 92% tile height; no independently centering the parts. The three tiles are different depth parts that will overlay to reconstruct ONE complete castle: LEFT tile contains rear spires/roofline and rear architecture only, MIDDLE tile contains main facade/building body and central architecture only, RIGHT tile contains front terraces, front rock island foundation, vegetation and waterfalls only. Keep back spires high in the frame and front rock foundation low; transparent space where the other parts belong. Complete hidden architecture behind the front parts slightly so parallax won't reveal holes. These are separated depth plates of ONE castle, NOT three castles, NOT three zoom crops, NOT an entire repeated castle in each tile. Crisp sharp miniature architectural detail, clean antialiased genuine alpha edges, no haze blur, no glow sheet, no excessive bloom. Genuine transparent background. No text, labels, grid lines, borders, UI, sea plane, clouds, sky or moon. Castle to extract: LEFT Radiant castle only, ivory-white marble, fine pale gold, blue crystalline windows and cool cyan waterfall light. Keep its tall noble celestial silhouette.

name: mountain-depth
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: the attached atlas of three blue mountain ranges. Decompose these SAME three ranges into actual registered depth plates, preserving their natural geology, rich sharp rock texture, blue-gray coloration and silhouettes. Output ONE high-resolution square 3x3 transparent atlas. Rows correspond to the three different original mountain ranges. Columns correspond to depth: column 1 distant back peaks, column 2 middle mountain faces and slopes, column 3 low foreground crags and rocky foot. For each row, use identical framing, scale, common ground line at 92% tile height and pixel alignment in all three tiles, so overlaying that row's three plates reconstructs ONE whole mountain range. Keep distant peaks high in the frame and foreground crags low; all missing other-layer regions must be truly transparent. Slightly complete hidden rock behind foreground forms to support parallax. Do NOT repeat a full range in each tile. Do NOT independently center or zoom each plate. Crisp premium realistic rock illustration, high contrast detail, no blur, no opaque fog, no broad opaque mist base. Genuine transparent alpha outside the rocks, with tiny soft edge antialiasing only. No landscape sky, sea, buildings, vegetation forest, moon, UI, text, labels, frames or grid lines. All nine tiles have equal dimensions and clean transparent padding between subjects.
